main_text.p: Belgiautbt, Irafcēre] Quod ad hoc & duo proximè præcedentia verba,(belgon,& belgon sal) vide Abalgt, supra.
Befcedltolt, Obscurabitur: quasi à schadatoe, Umbra]. Ab eādem origine nostrum thadatw, Saxonibus rcaoupe? Teutonicis hodie befchaedatwen, obumbrare, Sax. rceaopian?
Befcurgt, Præcipita: & befco?gin-gun, Præcipitationis. vide Discurgtdt.
Befuebet, Soporatus] Somnus, sopor, somnium, Saxon. rpepn, & rpe-pene?
Befulck, supplanta. Suprà, befbf-cbetde, Scandalum] Saxonico convenit berpican, supplantare.
.Bethadon, Absconderunt, alibi be-baton, idem] Saxonico respondet hyoan, behyoan, Belg. boeden, abscon-dere,tegere; unde nostrum hodiernum bide, sive to bide, illo sensu.
Bitpollon, Infecta: bitpollona, Inquinatæ: bitpellan, Prophanabo] Quasi à tupl, Teutonicis, turpis, forȷdidus, immundus, quod nobis hodie fotole,Sax. pul? Inquinatum quid dicimus befolwillen.

page.notes: Handwritten marks at top right ("2 2 0" style numerals) and stains along the edges are not printed text and are omitted. Black letter headwords are marked with bl; some Saxon and Greek-derived forms are doubtful and may contain errors. The final word "Bewiltdf," is the catchword at the foot of the column.
